cleared.check: Task 1 to 4 on Ethereum: every mined PoolManager transaction of the window re-run through a model of src/ from its prestate and compared word by word with what the chain returned, logged and stored. scripts/model.py rewrites every PoolManager entry point from the text of src/ (PoolManager.sol:103-377, ProtocolFees.sol, ERC6909.sol, ERC6909Claims.sol, Extsload.sol, Exttload.sol, Pool.sol:100-612, Position.sol, TickBitmap.sol, Hooks.sol:131-320) with the pool math of tools/opdiff/v4math.py, and walks the mined call trace frame by frame. It starts persistent storage from the transaction's own prestate (prestateTracer), so tick bitmap words, liquidityNet and fee growth outside are the values at the transaction's position in its block, and starts transient storage empty. It takes from the trace only what the source takes from outside: calldata, msg.sender, msg.value, hook return data and token balanceOf return data. For every PoolManager frame it compares the frame output (swap and modifyLiquidity deltas, feesAccrued, settle amount, unlock result, every extsload and exttload word), every PoolManager log word (Swap, ModifyLiquidity, Donate, Initialize, ERC-6909 Transfer and others), and the deltas the PoolManager wrote into the calldata of afterSwap and afterAdd or afterRemoveLiquidity hooks. At the end it compares every PoolManager storage word in the prestateTracer diff (slot0, liquidity, both fee growth globals, tick words, bitmap words, positions, protocolFeesAccrued, ERC-6909 balances, allowances, operators) and flags any word it wrote that the chain did not, and any word the chain wrote that it did not. A model read of a word that is not in the prestate is also flagged.

cleared.check: Monad: which code path the traces and the committed state come from, read in the v0.16.7 source that the endpoints report (Monad/0.16.7).
cleared.result: Trace requests re-execute from the parent block with the RPC VM, declared as vm::VM vm_{vm::VM::InterpreterOnly} (category/rpc/monad_executor.cpp:1306-1309, used at 1821-1824). Block execution builds vm::VM vm{trace_calls ? InterpreterOnly : Dual} (cmd/monad/main.cpp:485-488), so validators that do not record call traces run compiled native code. Every node asserts that the delayed execution results carried in each consensus header hash to the block headers it computed itself (category/execution/runloop/runloop_monad.cpp:125-155, MONAD_ASSERT at 680-681). So the 20,000 transactions checked against the source above were run by the interpreter, and the committed state they match (1,500 blocks, scripts/committed.py) is accepted by the node only while its own results equal what the validator quorum executed. Whether rpc.monad.xyz itself runs with trace_calls was not confirmed.

cleared.check: Reading of unlock when the callback returns data whose first word is 0.
cleared.result: Two Unichain transactions return 64 bytes from unlockCallback with a head word of 0. abi.decode reads the length at offset 0, which is 0, and unlock returns empty bytes (src/PoolManager.sol:104-114). The chain did the same. The model first assumed an offset of 32 and was corrected. The other corrections made during the unit were a read of tick liquidity words in the fee growth computation that the source does not make (Pool.sol:493-494 reads only the fee growth words; the prestate showed it) and the counting of wrapped native Deposit and Withdrawal logs. After them every transaction of every window replays.

leads.question: Can the BNB Smart Chain replay reach 20,000 transactions through an archive trace endpoint, or through a replay from parent-block storage as cycle 21 did for Arc?
leads.why: The public trace endpoints keep state for a few hours at most (required historical state unavailable, reexec=128; historical state is not available), so the BNB Chain window here is about 1706 transactions.

leads.question: Do PoolManager transactions without a PoolManager log (native settle and take only, clear, sync, updateDynamicLPFee, collectProtocolFees) replay to the source as well?
leads.why: Every window here was listed from PoolManager logs, so a transaction that moves native value or changes slot0 without a log was outside it. block or trace_filter listings would close this.

leads.question: Does the HyperEVM validator write the same PoolManager words as the replica block by block, for words that were later overwritten?
leads.why: The official endpoint serves only the latest state, so only the last value of each word over the whole history was compared. A follow mode that compares each new block with the official latest state while it is still latest would cover every write.

leads.question: Does rpc.monad.xyz execute blocks with trace_calls (interpreter only), and do the delayed execution results carry the state root?
leads.why: If so, the committed state comparison checks the interpreter against the interpreter, and only the consensus assertion ties it to validators running compiled code.

leads.question: Does the same word by word replay hold on the eleven networks outside this unit (OP Mainnet, Zora, World Chain, Ink, Soneium, Celo, X Layer, Robinhood Chain, Elysium, Tempo, Arc)?
leads.why: L-996 named ten networks. For the other eleven the answer is unknown here; Arc and Elysium serve no traces (cycle 22), so they need the parent-state replay of cycle 21.

leads.question: Does https://mainnet.megaeth.com/rpc serve state it executed itself or state diffs from the sequencer?
leads.why: The 16,035 block comparison of traced and committed state is a producer check only in the second case.

leadResults.answer: 163758 mined PoolManager transactions were replayed word by word against a model of src/ on the ten networks the lead names: Ethereum, Unichain, Arbitrum One, Monad and MegaETH 20,000 each, Base 19,987, Polygon 19981, Avalanche 19251, HyperEVM its whole history of 2833, BNB Smart Chain 1706 (state kept only for hours). 3929348 words were compared, 500370 of them PoolManager storage words the chains changed. No storage word, return value, log word or hook calldata word differs from the source. In every transaction the PoolManager native balance change equals native settles minus native takes and fee collection, and the traced value frames, to the wei (61698 transactions moved native value). 276847 ERC-20 currency and transaction pairs net to settle minus take; the residue is wrapped native Deposit logs, interest-bearing rounding, one rebasing token and one token without Transfer events. The traced post state equals the committed state on every block sampled on the 8 networks checked that way, the HyperEVM validator's latest state equals the replayed history in all 3395 words, and the Monad node asserts its own results against the consensus delayed execution results. The other eleven networks were outside the lead and this unit, so the answer for them is unknown here.
Not attempted in this unit. The time went to L-996, which covers the rows the census skips. The census gaps on Base, Robinhood Chain, Ethereum and X Layer stay as listed in cycle 22.
